latest_release.name: v3.8.9
latest_release.body:
## Upgrade notice

Document titles can now include `/`. Use the new version to open and edit these documents. We recommend updating the devices that access the same data and checking that your plugins are compatible, to avoid older versions overwriting your changes. See [the compatibility details](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/19938).

## Overview

This release adds support for `/` in document titles and improves mind maps, database automations, mobile editing, and file change detection.

### Mind maps and editing

Mind maps gain themes, global styling, node selection and clipboard operations, improved summaries, and list-style editing interactions.

Tables support adjustable row heights, with improvements to cell activation, text formatting performance, and Markdown list copying and export.

### Databases and navigation

Database automations support collecting block references, attribute name substring and regex matching, and subdocument depth limits.

Backlinks can be filtered by database fields, new database items have configurable opening behavior, and mobile documents can display backlinks at the bottom.

### Platforms and reliability

This release improves iOS text selection and editing, mobile search navigation, sync progress and cancellation, and file change detection for snapshots, sync, and restoration.

It also adds Windows title bar overlay, macOS system proxy detection, TIFF previews, and custom lock screen wallpapers, and updates runtimes and CA certificates.

## Changelogs

Below are the detailed changes in this version.

### Enhancement

* [Improve Markdown list formatting when copying and exporting](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/12192)
* [Support `/` in document titles](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/19938)
* [Improve editing, database view, and search performance](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20692)
* [Support hiding parent paths in embedded block breadcrumbs](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20698)
* [Support pinning agent sessions](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20699)
* [Support maximizing and restoring PDF panes across platforms](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20701)
* [Support selecting, copying, cutting and pasting mind map nodes](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20703)
* [Improve mind map toolbar grouping and narrow layouts](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20723)
* [Improve table cell activation and context menus](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20728)
* [Improve mind map summary connectors and creation previews](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20732)
* [Support moving document tabs back to the main window](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20735)
* [Support closing detached windows with their last tab](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20736)
* [Improve performance when formatting text in pasted tables](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20751)
* [Support limiting subdocument depth in database automation scopes](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20753)
* [Support backlinks at the bottom of documents on mobile](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20756)
* [Improve sync checkout progress and cancellation](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20763)
* [Support TIFF image previews](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20764)
* [Improve database auto-collection with attribute name substring and regex matching](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20781)
* [Support clearing recent document history](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20785)
* [Improve mouse side button navigation](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20789)
* [Support custom lock screen wallpaper](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20797)
* [Support mind map themes and global styling](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20800)
*
